nonblocking_observations.text: The opening says date-only, then the immediately following shared explanation says a date but no flight schedule. The descriptor and its nearby explanation overlap. I treat this as minor adjacent redundancy within the introductory disclosure, not a material repeat of shared-limit explanations throughout the answer. Removing the first date-only would tighten prose; no runtime edit is made.
